Local metres around each anchor: +x east, +z south (three.js local axes before rotation). buildings = this build's footprints as the app has them (decoded from site/gbadata): ring, h (the app's height: OSM height / levels where mapped, otherwise an estimate; Shenzhen has levels on ~19 % of its OSM footprints, and part of the city comes from other footprint sources without heights), type, area, centroid; osm / name / zh / floors when an OSM building outline covers it (matched by position, so a footprint without osm is not in OSM or is split differently). parts = the app's building:part pieces inside the footprint with base / top. target = true on the app footprints that lie on the target's own OSM footprint (meta.osm). roads = the app's road lines: cls 0-1 freeway, 2-9 arterials, 10 local, 11 service, 12 path, 13 runway, 14 taxiway, 15 rail, 16 people mover, 17 pier; bridge; elev = deck height above the ground per vertex (the app's data has no OSM layer). areas = OSM land-use / leisure / amenity / natural / tourism polygons clipped to the box. pois = named OSM nodes. terrain = ground heights (m) on a grid around the anchor (rows north to south; the app's grid). ground = terrain height at the anchor. sel = what was listed: the box, or for big sites only what lies within 200 m of the target's own footprint.
